contexts.text: Can there be shame without reverence? SE 1051.
As fear = holiness, by the same word in the Original is meant veneration and reverence, which likewise is holy fear.
Love to God becomes... love in which there is holy reverence, with those in celestial worship.
The Holy which then inflows, induces something of fear with holy reverence.
Thou shalt not revere a poor man in his cause () = that the falsities of those who are in ignorance of truth are not to be favoured.
He reverently introduced them to the prince.
That there is no need to revere any Spirit. Explained.
They esteem above all others those who are without fear, reverence, and shame.
That fear is of shame, and also of reverence. Explained.
To fear Jehovah God involves... to revere, consequently to worship reverently. Illustrated.
